'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jonathan Murray DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''This deck is good'''. Username '''Throdo'''. Handwritten. L2 Hoth: Main Power Generators V-box scribbled out (not V). L7 written You May Start Landing. L11 written Generators, entered Target The Main Generator. L14 sheet Gannor (V) → Garindan (V). L17 sheet General Newer → General Veers. L19 Veers (V) → General Veers (V). L24 Black Leader (V) → DS-61-2 (V). L27 written The Emperor's Reach. L33 Marquand in Blizz 6 kept as Marquand In Blizzard 6 (not Colonel Marquand). L34 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer. L45 sheet Hoth Boludage (V) → Hoth Blockade (V). L56–57 parentheticals (cp) and (dagobah) entered as the interrupt Control. Shield checkboxes are empty; a trailing handwritten v is (V). Imperial Detention and Resistance have no trailing v.

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
